Brush the roll with olive oil. Cook at 400°F for 10 minutes, or until the prosciutto is crisp and the pork is cooked through.
tip: Secure the roll with kitchen twine to maintain its shape during cooking.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Stuffed Jalapeños
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
description: Jalapeño peppers filled with a savory mixture of ground pork and Cheddar cheese, wrapped in bacon. The filling remains moist while the bacon crisps during cooking.
instructions: Halve the peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds and pith.
In a bowl, combine the ground pork, shredded cheese, salt, and pepper. Mix thoroughly.
Fill each pepper half with the pork and cheese mixture.
Wrap each stuffed pepper half with a slice of bacon. Secure with a toothpick if needed.
Arrange the peppers in the basket. Cook until the bacon is crisp and the filling is cooked through.
tip: For less spiciness, thoroughly remove all seeds and pith from the jalapeños. Shake the basket or turn the peppers halfway through cooking for even results.

title: Beef and Coriander Kofta Skewers
ingredients: 0.7 oz Ras el Hanout Spice Blend
description: A mixture of ground beef and herbs, shaped onto skewers and cooked to achieve a grilled texture and aroma. This dish is inspired by Middle Eastern flavors.
instructions: Finely chop the shallots. Sauté in a pan with olive oil until translucent.
In a mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, sautéed shallots, fresh coriander, ras el hanout, and cumin.
Knead the mixture until all ingredients are evenly incorporated. Season with salt and pepper as needed.
Divide the mixture into equal portions. Shape each portion into a log and press firmly onto a skewer.
Arrange the skewers in a single layer in the cooking basket. Cook at 355°F / 180°C for 8 minutes, turning once at the halfway point.
tip: Serve with a yogurt and mint sauce.

title: Minted Lamb Meatballs
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves and 2 small shallots, finely minced
0.1 oz fresh mint and 0.35 oz fresh parsley, chopped
0.1 oz ground cumin and 0.17 fl oz hot sauce
0.68 fl oz lemon juice and 0.5 fl oz olive oil, plus additional for brushing
description: Ground lamb meatballs seasoned with garlic, shallots, mint, and parsley. Cooked at high temperature to create a crisp exterior.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground lamb, finely minced garlic, and shallots.
Add chopped herbs, ground cumin, hot sauce, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Mix all ingredients by hand until thoroughly combined.
Shape the mixture into small, uniform meatballs. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to firm.
Brush meatballs with oil. Place them in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 11 minutes.
tip: Serve with a yogurt or tzatziki sauce.

title: Soy and Miso Glazed Meatballs
description: Meatballs seasoned with miso and mint, coated in a sweet and savory soy-mirin glaze. The high-heat cooking method ensures a perfectly caramelized exterior.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, miso paste, sesame oil, and chopped mint.
With oiled hands, form the mixture into uniform meatballs. Refrigerate for 15 minutes to firm.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, soy sauce, and mirin to create the glaze.
Arrange the chilled meatballs in the cooking basket.
Cook at 390°F for 11 minutes, basting the meatballs with the glaze every 2-3 minutes until fully cooked and caramelized.
tip: For an even glaze, brush the meatballs every 2 minutes. Shake the basket or turn the meatballs halfway through the cooking time to ensure uniform cooking.

title: Roasted Whole Sausages
description: An efficient method for cooking moist, well-browned sausages. This technique uses hot air circulation to cook the interior thoroughly while crisping the casing, without the need for pricking.
instructions: Remove sausages from the refrigerator a few minutes prior to cooking.
Arrange sausages in a single layer in the cooking basket, ensuring no overlap for proper air circulation.
Cook at 400°F for 8-10 minutes, adjusting time based on sausage thickness.
Halfway through the cooking time, turn the sausages with tongs to ensure even browning.
tip: Do not prick the sausage casings before cooking to retain internal juices.

title: Mustard Glazed Sausage Spiral
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
description: A continuous sausage coiled into a spiral, glazed with a mustard and honey mixture that caramelizes during cooking. Suitable for indoor grilling applications.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the honey, both mustards, thyme leaves, salt, and pepper.
Coil the continuous sausage into a tight spiral. Secure the shape by inserting two crossed wooden skewers.
Brush the entire surface of the sausage with the mustard glaze.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F. Place the sausage spiral onto the cooking surface.
Cook for 10 minutes, turning the spiral over at the 5-minute mark to ensure even browning.
tip: Use two crossed skewers to secure the spiral shape during cooking. Turning the sausage halfway through is essential for a uniform crust.

title: Steak and Horseradish Sandwich
ingredients: 0.85 fl oz extra virgin olive oil
description: A hot sandwich featuring roasted steak and a pungent horseradish sauce. The sauce complements the richness of the meat.
instructions: Season the steak on all sides with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F. Cook the steak for approximately 6 minutes for rare to medium doneness.
In a bowl, combine the sour cream, horseradish, minced chives, minced shallot, and lemon juice to prepare the sauce.
Remove the steak and let it rest on a cutting board for 5-10 minutes. Slice against the grain.
Toast the buns. Spread the horseradish sauce on the buns. Assemble the sandwich with fresh arugula and the sliced steak.
tip: Rest the steak for 5-10 minutes before slicing to ensure juices are retained.

title: Shawarma-Spiced Lamb Skewers
description: Ground lamb skewers seasoned with a blend of Middle Eastern spices. The cooking process ensures even roasting and a well-formed exterior crust.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the ground lamb with paprika, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, cinnamon, turmeric, fennel seeds, coriander, and salt.
Knead the mixture by hand to evenly distribute the spices.
Divide the mixture and form it around wooden skewers into cylindrical shapes.
Refrigerate the skewers for 10 minutes to firm.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F. Cook for 9 minutes, turning the skewers halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Serve with a yogurt and mint sauce.

title: Teriyaki Pork Skewers
description: Cubed pork loin coated in a homemade teriyaki glaze. The cooking process caramelizes the sugar, creating a glossy, sticky coating.
instructions: In a small saucepan, dissolve the cornstarch in cold water. Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for approximately 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens. Set aside to cool slightly.
Thread the pork cubes onto wooden skewers. Reserve half of the sauce for glazing. Coat the skewers with the remaining sauce and marinate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F. Place the skewers in the basket and apply a light coat of cooking spray.
Cook for a total of 9 minutes.
During the cooking process, brush the skewers with the reserved teriyaki sauce every 2 minutes to build a glaze.
tip: Apply additional teriyaki sauce every 2 minutes during cooking to create a thick, caramelized layer.

title: Korean-Style Beef Skewers
description: Beef skewers marinated in a blend of Korean pastes, soy sauce, and honey, offering a balance of spicy, salty, and sweet flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ssamjang, gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, and rice vinegar to create the marinade.
Add the beef chunks to the marinade. Ensure all pieces are evenly coated. Refrigerate and marinate for at least one hour.
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers. If necessary, cut skewers to fit the cooking appliance.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F.
Arrange the skewers in the appliance. Cook for 7 minutes at 400°F, until the exterior is browned and the interior is cooked through.
tip: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for at least 10 minutes prior to use to prevent burning.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Beef Skewers
description: Melted cheese encased in beef slices. A honey and soy marinade caramelizes the exterior during cooking.
instructions: Remove rind from cheese. Cut cheese into sticks, approximately 0.6 inches thick.
Thread cheese sticks onto wooden skewers. Wrap each cheese stick completely with a beef carpaccio slice, pressing firmly to seal.
Whisk together soy sauce and honey. Marinate the skewers in the mixture for 1 hour in the refrigerator.
Place the skewers in the preheated cooking basket.
Cook at 350°F for 6 minutes. Flip skewers halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning and melting of the cheese.
tip: Wrap the beef firmly around the cheese to prevent leakage during cooking.

title: Scotch Eggs
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
description: A classic British dish featuring a hard-boiled egg encased in seasoned sausage meat, coated in breadcrumbs, and cooked until golden brown.
instructions: In a bowl, combine the pork sausage meat with garlic powder, onion powder, sage, salt, and pepper. Mix thoroughly and divide into four equal portions.
Flatten one portion of the sausage meat into a patty. Place a hard-boiled egg in the center and mold the meat around it, ensuring a complete and even seal. Repeat for all eggs.
Prepare three separate shallow dishes for flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs. Coat each sausage-wrapped egg first in flour, then dip in the egg, and finally roll in breadcrumbs until fully covered.
Preheat the appliance to 350°F. Arrange the breaded eggs in the basket and spray their entire surface with cooking oil.
Cook for 15 minutes. Turn the eggs halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Generously spray the breaded eggs with cooking oil to achieve a golden-brown and crisp exterior.

title: Coconut Macaroons
description: Macaroons with a soft, moist interior and a toasted exterior. The recipe is designed for quick cooking that retains moisture.
instructions: In a clean bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk, almond extract, and vanilla extract.
Gradually incorporate the dried coconut flakes, mixing gently to prevent the mixture from deflating.
Portion the mixture into small mounds onto a parchment-lined tray or basket.
Cook at 300°F for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
tip: Allow the macaroons to cool completely on the parchment paper before handling to prevent breakage.

title: Breaded Avocado Wedges
description: Avocado wedges with a crisp, spiced breading. The interior remains soft, creating a textural contrast.
instructions: Halve, pit, and peel the avocados. Slice into uniform wedges.
Prepare three shallow dishes: one with flour and salt; one with beaten eggs; one with breadcrumbs, paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Dredge each avocado wedge in the flour, dip in the egg, then coat completely with the seasoned breadcrumbs.
Arrange the breaded wedges in a single layer in the basket. Spray generously with cooking spray.
Cook at 400°F for 11 minutes, turning the wedges halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Use avocados that are ripe but firm to prevent them from breaking apart during preparation.

title: French Toast Sticks
description: Bread sticks coated in an egg batter, cooked until crisp, and rolled in a cinnamon-sugar mixture. Suitable for breakfast or as a snack.
instructions: Cut each bread slice into 3 even strips.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
In a separate dish, combine granulated sugar and ground cinnamon.

Preheat the appliance to 350°F. Dip each bread strip into the egg mixture, allowing excess to drip off. Arrange the strips in a single layer in the cooking basket, previously coated with non-stick spray.
Cook for 10 minutes, turning the sticks over at the 5-minute mark. Immediately after cooking, roll the hot sticks in the cinnamon-sugar mixture to coat.
tip: Turn the sticks halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning. Coat the sticks in the sugar mixture immediately after cooking while they are still hot for best adherence.

title: Breaded Fish Sticks
description: Cook frozen breaded fish sticks directly from the freezer. This method requires no additional fat.
instructions: Place frozen breaded fish sticks directly from the freezer into the basket.
Arrange the fish sticks in a single layer to ensure proper air circulation.
Cook at 400°F for 8-10 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
Serve immediately. Garnish with fresh lemon juice if desired.
tip: Do not add extra oil if the fish sticks are pre-fried. The existing oil content is sufficient for cooking.

title: Blooming Onion
description: A classic American appetizer consisting of a large onion, cut to resemble a flower, battered, and cooked until crisp.
instructions: Peel the onions and cut off the top. Make eight deep, evenly spaced downward cuts starting from the center, without cutting through the base.
Submerge the onions in ice-cold water for a minimum of 2 hours to allow the petals to separate.
In a separate bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, sweet paprika, salt, garlic powder, chili flakes, and dried oregano. Gradually whisk in the water until a smooth batter forms.

Remove the onions from the water and drain thoroughly. Dip each onion into the batter, ensuring all petals are coated inside and out. Sprinkle breadcrumbs evenly over the entire surface, including between the petals.

Lightly spray the battered onion with cooking oil. Place it in the air fryer basket. Cook at 400°F for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°F and cook for an additional 15 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through.
tip: Adhere to the minimum 2-hour soaking time in ice water. This step is crucial for the onion petals to open correctly.

title: Salmon Fillets
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: This cooking method caramelizes the exterior of the fillet while maintaining a tender, moist, and flaky interior.
instructions: Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels.
Brush the fillets with neutral oil and season with flaky sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Place the fillets in the cooking basket, skin-side down.
Cook at 400°F for 8 to 10 minutes.
Remove immediately and serve.
tip: To prevent overcooking, check for doneness with a fork after 8 minutes of cooking time.

title: Breaded Cod Fillets
ingredients: 2.1 oz butter, cut into small pieces
description: A classic breaded cod recipe. The breading achieves a crisp texture while the butter provides richness and ensures a golden-brown finish.
instructions: Cut cod fillets into uniform 1.5-inch cubes. Pat dry with a paper towel and season with freshly ground black pepper.
In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, minced tarragon, and lemon juice. Mix until smooth and set aside.
Prepare a breading station with three shallow dishes. Place flour in the first, beaten eggs in the second, and breadcrumbs in the third.
Dredge each cod cube first in flour, then dip in the egg mixture, ensuring it is fully coated. Finally, press into the breadcrumbs to adhere.
Arrange the breaded cod pieces in a single layer in the basket. Place a small piece of butter on top of each cube.
Cook at 355°F for 12 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve immediately with the prepared tarragon sauce.
tip: Do not omit the butter. As it melts, it bastes the fish, creating a golden, flavorful crust and preventing dryness.

title: Strawberry Scones
description: Traditional British tea cakes featuring fresh strawberries. This recipe yields a light, flaky texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and granulated sugar.
Cut cold butter into small cubes. Using fingertips, rub the butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Incorporate the chopped strawberries into the mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and one egg. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry mixture and stir gently to combine.
Form the dough into a thick disc. Cut into equal wedges. Brush the tops with the remaining beaten egg. Place on parchment paper and bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.
tip: Work the dough quickly and keep the butter cold to achieve a light and flaky texture.

title: Blueberry and Ginger Scones
description: Scones featuring blueberries and fresh ginger. The fruit provides a tart contrast to the spice of the ginger. Serve warm.
instructions: In a large bowl, sift together flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gently fold in the blueberries and grated ginger.
In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, one egg, and vanilla extract. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
On a lightly floured surface, pat the dough into a 1-inch thick disc and cut into eight wedges.
In a small bowl, beat the remaining egg with a splash of water. Brush the tops of the wedges with the egg wash.
Arrange the wedges on parchment paper, ensuring they are spaced apart. Cook for 12 minutes.
tip: For a golden-brown finish, brush the surface of the scones with an egg wash (one beaten egg mixed with a small amount of water) before cooking.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Shrimp
description: Bacon is wrapped around shrimp and cooked until crisp. The rendering bacon fat bastes the shrimp, resulting in a savory appetizer.
instructions: Combine garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and paprika in a small bowl.
Season the shrimp with the spice mixture.
Cut each bacon strip in half crosswise.
Wrap one piece of bacon around each shrimp.
Secure the bacon with a toothpick.
Arrange the wrapped shrimp in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 320°F for 16 minutes, or until the bacon is crisp.
Transfer the shrimp to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess fat. Serve immediately.
tip: A toothpick is essential to prevent the bacon from unwrapping during cooking.

title: Coconut-Crusted Shrimp
description: A recipe for shrimp with a sweet and savory coconut crust, cooked to achieve a crisp texture without deep-frying.
instructions: In a shallow bowl, combine flour, salt, and desired seasonings.
In a second bowl, whisk together eggs and milk. In a third bowl, combine breadcrumbs and shredded coconut.
Dredge each shrimp in the flour mixture, dip in the egg wash, then coat thoroughly with the coconut-breadcrumb mixture, pressing to adhere.
Arrange the coated shrimp in a single layer in the preheated cooking basket. Lightly spray with cooking oil.
Cook at 350°F for 8 minutes, turning the shrimp over at the 4-minute mark.
tip: Press the coating firmly onto the shrimp to ensure it adheres during cooking. A generous spray of neutral oil will promote a golden-brown, crisp crust.

title: Double-Breaded Curry Shrimp
description: Double-breaded shrimp coated in a curry-spiced flour and coarse cornmeal. This recipe yields a crispy exterior and a tender interior.
instructions: Prepare a three-stage breading station. Place the beaten eggs in the first bowl, the combined flour and curry powder in the second, and the coarse cornmeal in the third.
Coat each shrimp in the beaten eggs.
Allow excess egg to drip off, then dredge the shrimp in the flour and curry mixture, ensuring complete coverage.
Press the coated shrimp firmly into the coarse cornmeal to form a thick crust.
Arrange the breaded shrimp in the cooking basket in a single layer. Drizzle with oil. Cook for 10 minutes, shaking the basket at the halfway point.
tip: Allowing excess egg to drip off before applying the dry coatings is crucial for achieving a crisp, non-soggy crust.

title: Spiced Curry and Coconut Cod
description: Cod fillets seasoned with Indian curry paste and served with a coconut cream sauce. A preparation method that keeps the fish tender and moist.
instructions: Coat the cod fillets evenly with 2 tablespoons of curry paste.
In a small saucepan, combine the remaining tablespoon of curry paste with the coconut cream. Heat gently and season with salt and pepper.
Place a sheet of parchment paper on a baking tray and arrange the cod fillets on top.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the cod hot, garnished with the warm coconut sauce and shredded coconut.
tip: Lining the baking tray with parchment paper prevents the fish from sticking and facilitates easier cleanup.

title: Panko-Crusted Cod Fillets
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: Cod fillets with a crispy lemon-herb panko crust.
instructions: Season both sides of each cod fillet with salt.
In a bowl, combine the Panko breadcrumbs, melted butter, parsley, lemon zest, lemon juice, and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Distribute the mixture evenly over the top of each fillet, pressing lightly to adhere.
Place the fillets in the cooking basket with the breaded side facing up.
Cook at 340°F for 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
tip: Press the breading firmly onto the fillets to ensure it adheres and forms a compact crust.

title: Mini Apple Pies
ingredients: 1 medium apple, peeled and finely diced
1 sheet pre-made pie crust (shortcrust or puff pastry)
description: Shortcrust pastry pockets with an apple and spice filling.
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt the butter. Sauté the diced apple with sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice until softened.
Cut two circles from the pastry sheet. Place the apple filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the pastry into a half-moon shape. Seal the edges firmly.
Cut a small slit on the surface of each pie to allow steam to escape during cooking.
Combine the beaten egg and milk. Brush the exterior of the pies with the resulting egg wash. Cook at 350°F for 10 minutes.
tip: A small incision on the pastry surface prevents steam buildup. Flip the pies halfway through the cooking time for even browning.

title: Breaded Mozzarella Bites
description: Double-breaded mozzarella pieces with a molten center, cooked to a golden-brown finish.
instructions: Cut each mozzarella stick into uniform pieces.
Prepare three shallow dishes. In the first, combine flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper. In the second, whisk together eggs and milk. In the third, combine breadcrumbs and dried parsley.
Dredge each mozzarella piece in the flour mixture, dip it into the egg mixture, then coat with the breadcrumb mixture. Repeat the egg and breadcrumb steps for a thicker crust.
Place the breaded pieces on a tray and freeze for at least 15 minutes.
Arrange the frozen pieces in a single layer in the basket. Spray generously with non-stick cooking spray. Cook at 350°F for 8 minutes, turning them halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Freezing the breaded pieces prevents the cheese from leaking during cooking. Turn the pieces halfway through to ensure even browning.

title: Coffee and Cocoa Muffins
description: Moist muffins with a pronounced coffee and cocoa flavor profile.
instructions: In a large bowl, sift and combine the flour, cocoa powder, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and espresso powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined and no lumps remain. Do not overmix.
Fill muffin liners three-quarters full.
Bake at 300°F for 15 minutes.
tip: Use paper liners. Do not fill past the three-quarters mark.

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
description: A classic recipe for muffins with chocolate chips.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine milk, melted butter, and eggs.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, and chocolate chips.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients. Stir briefly until just combined. Do not overmix.
Portion the batter into greased muffin cups.
Cook at 340°F for 20 minutes.
tip: Use silicone muffin cups or sturdy paper liners.

title: Grilled Sea Bream with Olives
description: Sea bream fillets served with a raw Mediterranean-style salsa.
instructions: To prepare the salsa, combine diced tomatoes, sliced olives, minced garlic, and chopped parsley in a bowl. Season with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Pat the sea bream fillets dry with a paper towel. Brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Preheat the grill plate to 400°F (200°C) for 15 minutes.
Place the fillets on the preheated grill plate. Cook for 7 minutes. Do not flip the fillets.
Remove the fillets using a wide spatula. Serve immediately, topped with the prepared salsa.
tip: Ensure the grill plate is thoroughly preheated to achieve distinct grill marks.

title: Cajun Catfish Fillets
description: Catfish fillets seasoned with a Louisiana-style spice blend, resulting in a smoky and spicy flavor profile.
instructions: Pat the fish fillets dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, combine paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, basil, oregano, and cayenne pepper to create the spice rub.
Coat both sides of the fish fillets evenly with the spice rub.
Spray the fillets generously with cooking spray and place them in the preheated air fryer basket.
Cook at 350°F for 7 minutes, or until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
tip: For a well-developed crust, ensure the seasoned fillets are generously coated with cooking spray before cooking.

title: Breakfast Pizza with Egg and Ham
description: A savory pizza featuring a crispy crust, melted mozzarella, smoked ham, and a centrally placed egg.
instructions: Brush the pizza base surface with olive oil.
Distribute the shredded mozzarella and chopped smoked ham evenly over the base.
Place the pizza in the preheated appliance at 350°F and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove the pizza, crack the egg in the center, and immediately return it to the appliance.
Continue cooking for 3 minutes until the egg white is set. Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
tip: Add the egg during the final stage of cooking to maintain a soft, runny yolk.

title: Lemon Butter Salmon
ingredients: 1 fl oz lemon juice, freshly squeezed
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: Salmon fillets cooked to a tender texture, served with a classic lemon-butter sauce prepared separately.
instructions: Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Preheat to 350°F. Lightly coat the basket with cooking spray and place the salmon fillets inside.
Cook for 8 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
While the salmon cooks, combine butter, lemon juice, grated garlic, and Worcestershire sauce in a small saucepan. Melt over low heat for 1 minute.
Remove the salmon from the basket. Serve immediately, drizzled with the warm sauce.
tip: For optimal flavor, prepare the sauce separately and pour it over the salmon immediately before serving.

title: Salmon with Tomato and Cucumber Salad
description: A protein-rich dish featuring cooked salmon fillets served with a fresh vegetable salad.
instructions: Brush salmon fillets with oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook at 400°F for 7 to 9 minutes.
While salmon is cooking, combine chopped tomatoes, diced cucumber, minced onion, parsley, and dill in a bowl.
Dress the vegetable mixture with red wine vinegar and olive oil. Mix well.
Remove salmon from the appliance. Serve each fillet topped with the vegetable salad.
tip: Prepare the salad while the salmon is cooking. Check for doneness at the 7-minute mark.

title: Teriyaki-Glazed Salmon
description: Salmon fillets cooked to a tender, moist consistency, finished with a homemade teriyaki and orange glaze.
instructions: Combine soy sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger, and orange juice in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until the liquid has reduced by half, forming a thick glaze.
Cool the teriyaki sauce to room temperature.
Brush the salmon fillets with vegetable oil and season with white pepper.
Preheat the appliance to 350°F. Place the salmon fillets skin-side down in the basket. Cook for 8 minutes.
Remove the salmon from the basket. Let rest for 5 minutes. Brush the surface with the prepared teriyaki sauce before serving.
tip: Placing the salmon skin-side down protects the flesh from direct heat, ensuring a moist result.

title: Breakfast Muffin Sandwich
description: A classic breakfast sandwich featuring a toasted English muffin, melted cheddar cheese, Canadian bacon, and a steamed egg.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 320°F (160°C). Grease two small ramekins with non-stick cooking spray and place them in the basket to heat.
Top two English muffin halves with one slice of cheese and one slice of Canadian bacon each. Place all four muffin halves in the basket.
Carefully add 1 tablespoon of hot water to each hot ramekin. Crack an egg into each and season with salt and pepper.
Cook for a total of 10 minutes. Remove the muffin halves after 7 minutes.
Allow the eggs to cook for the final 3 minutes. Carefully remove the ramekins, assemble the sandwiches, and serve immediately.
tip: Adding hot water to the ramekins creates steam, which ensures the eggs are cooked gently.

title: Apple Puff Pastries
ingredients: 1 large egg, beaten for egg wash
description: Puff pastry rectangles topped with thinly sliced, spiced apples. The pastry rises to create a golden, crisp border around the fruit filling.
instructions: Slice apples thinly. Immediately toss with lemon juice to prevent oxidation.
Unroll chilled puff pastry. Cut into 8 equal rectangles.
With a knife tip, score a 0.4-inch border on each rectangle. Do not cut through the dough.
Combine apple slices with granulated sugar and cinnamon. Arrange the slices, overlapping, within the scored border of each pastry rectangle.
Brush the scored borders with the beaten egg. Cook at 355°F for 16 minutes, or until the pastry is risen and golden brown. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
tip: Scoring a 0.4-inch border allows the edges to rise significantly, creating a defined crust around the apple filling.

title: Fried Pickles
description: A crisp, breaded American appetizer featuring tangy dill pickles.
instructions: Thoroughly dry the pickles with paper towels. Slice them lengthwise into spears.
Prepare a three-stage breading station: one dish with flour, a second with beaten eggs, and a third with a mixture of breadcrumbs, paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Dredge each pickle spear in flour, then dip in the beaten egg, allowing excess to drip off. Finally, coat completely with the seasoned breadcrumb mixture.
Arrange the breaded spears in a single layer in the cooking basket. Spray evenly with cooking oil.
Cook at 356°F for 10 minutes. Flip the spears halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Ensure pickles are thoroughly dried before breading to guarantee a crisp coating that adheres properly.

title: Dark Chocolate Soufflé
ingredients: 1.1 oz unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
description: Individual chocolate soufflés with a light, aerated texture and a rich chocolate flavor.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the egg yolk with the cornstarch until smooth.

In a saucepan, bring the milk and half of the sugar to a simmer. Pour the hot liquid over the yolk mixture, whisking constantly. Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring, until it thickens.
Remove from heat. Incorporate the chopped chocolate and 1.1 oz of unsalted butter until fully melted and the mixture is smooth. Set aside to cool to a lukewarm temperature.
In a separate, clean bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gradually add the remaining sugar during the final stage of beating to stabilize the meringue.
Gently fold one-third of the beaten egg whites into the lukewarm chocolate base. Fold in the remaining egg whites in two additions, using an upward motion to maintain volume.
Prepare four heat-resistant ramekins by greasing them with butter and coating the interior with granulated sugar. Tap out any excess sugar.
Fill each prepared ramekin two-thirds full with the soufflé mixture.
Place the ramekins into the preheated appliance. Cook at 330°F for 13 minutes. Serve immediately, dusted with powdered sugar.
tip: Avoid opening the appliance during the cooking cycle. A sudden change in temperature can cause the soufflés to collapse.

title: Grilled Fish Tacos
ingredients: 16 oz White Fish Fillets, cut into strips
description: A quick recipe for fish tacos. The fish is coated in a cornmeal and spice mixture, resulting in a tender texture suitable for serving in warm tortillas.
instructions: In a shallow bowl, combine cornmeal, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Coat the fish strips evenly with the cornmeal mixture.
Lightly spray the coated fillets with oil. Arrange them in a single layer in the basket, preheated to 350°F.
Cook for 7 minutes, turning the fillets halfway through the cooking time.
Serve the cooked fish strips in soft tortillas. Garnish with lime juice and sauce as desired.
tip: Turn the fish fillets carefully during cooking to prevent them from breaking.

title: Stuffed French Toast
description: A variation of French toast featuring thick brioche bread with a cream cheese filling. The exterior is cooked to a golden-brown crust.
instructions: Using a knife, create a deep pocket in the center of each brioche slice. Fill each pocket with cream cheese.

In a shallow dish, whisk together the eggs, milk, and heavy cream. In a separate bowl, combine the sugar and cinnamon. Add half of the sugar-cinnamon mixture to the egg batter and whisk to combine. Reserve the other half for coating.
Preheat the appliance to 350°F.
Dip each stuffed brioche slice into the egg batter, ensuring complete saturation on both sides. Place the slices in the oiled basket.
Cook for 10 minutes, flipping at the 5-minute mark, until golden brown.
Remove from the basket. While hot, coat with the reserved sugar-cinnamon mixture. Garnish with crushed pistachios and serve immediately.
tip: Use stale bread for optimal absorption of the egg batter and to maintain structural integrity during cooking.

title: Soft Lemon Loaf Cake
description: A citrus-flavored loaf cake with a soft texture.
instructions: With an electric mixer, cream the softened butter for at least 3 minutes. Gradually add the sugar and continue mixing until combined.
Incorporate the egg, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, alternating with the buttermilk. Mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into a small, buttered loaf pan, filling it three-quarters full.
Place the pan in the preheated appliance. Cook at 320°F for 30 minutes.
tip: Cream the butter and sugar thoroughly to incorporate air, which results in a lighter cake texture.

title: Crispy Fish Cakes
description: Cook fish cakes directly from frozen to achieve a crisp exterior and a thoroughly heated interior.
instructions: Do not thaw fish cakes prior to cooking.
Arrange frozen fish cakes in a single layer within the cooking basket.
Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 12 to 15 minutes, adjusting time based on product size and thickness.
Flip the fish cakes halfway through the cooking cycle for uniform browning.
tip: For pre-fried or commercially breaded products, no additional oil is necessary.

title: Eggs in Cocotte with Bacon
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: A protein-rich breakfast dish of eggs baked in individual ramekins with bacon, spinach, and a Parmesan cream sauce.
instructions: Sauté diced bacon in a skillet for 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook until wilted, approximately 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together heavy cream and grated Parmesan cheese.
Coat four 3-inch heat-resistant ramekins with non-stick cooking spray. Divide the bacon and spinach mixture evenly among the ramekins.
Crack one egg into each ramekin. Pour the cream and cheese mixture over each egg.
Place the ramekins in the cooking basket. Cook at 350°F for 4-6 minutes, or until the egg whites are set.
tip: Ensure the egg whites are fully cooked while the yolk remains liquid.

title: Cheddar Cheese Biscuits
description: Flaky cheese biscuits suitable as an accompaniment for stews or soups.
instructions: Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar into a bowl.
Incorporate the cold, cubed butter using fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse sand.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese and buttermilk. Mix briefly until just combined.
Roll the dough to a 0.4-inch thickness. Cut out 4 large biscuits using a round cutter.
Brush the tops with melted butter. Place the biscuits on parchment paper and bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.
tip: Avoid overworking the dough to maintain a light and flaky texture.

title: English Muffin Pizzas
description: Miniature pizzas prepared on an English muffin base. A simple and quick recipe.
instructions: Halve the English muffins to create four bases.
Preheat the appliance to 338°F. Toast the muffin halves for 3 minutes to seal the surface.
Remove the bases. Spread tomato sauce evenly on each half.
Slice the mozzarella and arrange it over the sauce. Slice the olives and place them on top.
Place the pizzas in the basket. Cook at 338°F for 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden.
tip: For a variation, arrange the sliced olives to create patterns on the cheese before cooking.

title: Cranberry Muffins
description: Muffins with a balanced flavor profile of tart cranberries and citrus notes from orange juice and zest.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cranberries.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the orange juice, orange zest, and oil.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined; do not overmix.
Divide the batter among 8 prepared muffin cups.
Bake at 300°F for 15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
tip: Fill muffin cups no more than 3/4 full to prevent overflow during baking.

title: Dark Chocolate and Espresso Muffins
description: Muffins featuring a combination of cocoa and coffee flavors, suitable for a snack or breakfast.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the sifted flour, cocoa powder, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, instant espresso powder, and salt.
In a separate container, combine the egg, milk, oil, apple cider vinegar, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Mix with a spatula until just combined. Do not overmix.
Portion the batter into muffin liners, filling each two-thirds full.
Cook at 300°F for 15 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
tip: Use sturdy paper or silicone muffin liners to ensure the muffins hold their shape during cooking.

title: Savory Corn and Cheddar Muffins
description: Savory muffins featuring corn, cheddar cheese, and shallots. Best served warm.
instructions: In a large bowl, sift together all-purpose flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, milk, and melted butter. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Gently fold in the drained corn, sliced shallots, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Grease muffin molds and fill each with batter.
Place the molds in the appliance basket. Cook at 320°F for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
tip: Fill muffin molds to 3/4 capacity to allow for rising.

title: Lemon, Blueberry, and Coconut Muffins
description: A dairy-free and egg-free muffin recipe. The combination of coconut milk and lemon creates a soft texture and distinct flavor.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, coconut oil, sugar, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
Lightly coat the blueberries with flour. Gently fold them into the batter.
Portion the batter evenly into muffin liners placed inside the cooking basket.
Cook at 300°F for 15 minutes. Remove from the appliance and let cool completely before serving.
tip: To prevent the batter from discoloring, fold in the blueberries gently just before portioning.

title: Banana and Walnut Mini Loaf
description: A compact banana and walnut loaf. The interior is moist, complemented by the texture of the walnuts.
instructions: In a bowl, mash the bananas with a fork.
In a separate bowl, cream the softened butter and sugar. Mix in the beaten egg and vanilla extract.
Add the mashed bananas to the creamed mixture. Gradually incorporate the flour, baking soda, and salt.
Fold in the chopped walnuts and pour the batter into a greased mini loaf pan.
Place the pan in the appliance. Cook at 300°F for 40 minutes.
tip: Use a pan that fits inside the basket, leaving space around the edges for air circulation.

title: Roasted Asparagus
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: A quick and simple side dish. The asparagus tips become crisp and flavorful during cooking.
instructions: Wash the asparagus. Trim or snap off the woody lower ends of the stalks.
Place the asparagus in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and toss to coat evenly.
Season with salt and pepper.
Arrange the stalks in a single layer in the cooking basket or on the rack.
Cook at 400°F for 6 to 8 minutes.
Remove the asparagus when tender but still bright green.
tip: For optimal tenderness, snap the woody ends off by hand. The stalk will naturally break at the correct point.

title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Asparagus
description: An elegant side dish where tender asparagus is enveloped in a crisp, savory prosciutto shell.
instructions: Season the trimmed asparagus spears with salt and pepper.
Wrap one slice of prosciutto tightly around each asparagus spear.
Arrange the wrapped asparagus in a single layer in the preheated cooking basket at 300°F.
Lightly coat the prosciutto with olive oil.
Cook for 10 minutes, or until the prosciutto is crisp and browned.
tip: Use salt sparingly. The prosciutto is naturally salty and will season the asparagus during cooking.

title: Grilled Vegetable and Cream Cheese Bagels
description: A vegetarian bagel sandwich featuring grilled vegetables and a cream cheese-mustard spread. The components are heated and assembled for a warm serving.
instructions: Remove seeds and membranes from the bell peppers and slice into strips. Clean and slice the mushrooms.
In a bowl, toss the pepper strips and mushrooms with olive oil and oregano until evenly coated.
Cook the vegetables at 400°F for 12 minutes, tossing halfway through the cooking time.
Remove the cooked vegetables and set aside. Halve the bagels and toast them at 400°F for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine the cream cheese and mustard.
Spread the cream cheese mixture on the toasted bagel halves. Top with the cooked vegetables and serve immediately.
tip: For best results, cook the vegetables first, then toast the bread just before assembling. Serve immediately to ensure the sandwich is hot.

title: Spicy Breaded Cauliflower Bites
ingredients: 1 fl oz vegetable oil, for the glaze
description: Breaded cauliflower florets cooked until crisp and coated in a spicy Buffalo-style glaze.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, and salt. Gradually add milk, whisking continuously to form a thick batter.
Place panko breadcrumbs in a separate shallow bowl.
Dip each cauliflower floret into the batter, allowing excess to drip off. Press firmly into the panko breadcrumbs to ensure a complete coating.
Arrange the coated florets in a single layer in the cooking basket. Spray generously with vegetable oil spray.
Cook at 340°F for 27 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp.
While the cauliflower is cooking, combine the Buffalo sauce and 1 fl oz of vegetable oil in a large bowl.
Add the hot, cooked cauliflower to the sauce and toss gently to coat evenly. Serve immediately.
tip: For a uniform coating, toss the cooked cauliflower in the sauce while it is still hot.

title: Roasted Garlic Broccoli
ingredients: 1 large broccoli head, cut into florets
description: Broccoli florets seasoned and roasted to achieve a browned exterior, which enhances the flavor.
instructions: Coat the broccoli florets with oil.
Add garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the seasoned broccoli in a single layer. Cook at 300°F for 10 minutes.
Halfway through cooking, turn the florets to ensure even browning.
Serve immediately.
tip: Cut the broccoli florets to a uniform size to ensure even cooking.

title: Honey Soy Glazed Carrots
description: Baby carrots coated in a honey and soy sauce glaze, cooked to a caramelized finish. A balanced sweet and savory side dish.
instructions: Scrub the carrots under running water and pat dry.
In a bowl, combine carrots, soy sauce, honey, and olive oil. Toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the carrots in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 400°F for 13 minutes. Check for doneness after 12 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even glazing.
tip: Use carrots of a uniform size to ensure even cooking and consistent texture.

title: Honey-Roasted Carrots
ingredients: 0.5 fl oz extra virgin olive oil
description: A simple side dish featuring carrots roasted with honey and thyme. The final texture is tender-firm with a sweet glaze.
instructions: Pat the carrots dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine the carrots, honey, extra virgin olive oil, thyme sprigs, and salt.
Toss until the carrots are evenly coated.
Arrange the carrots in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook for 13 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Shake the cooking basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even cooking.

title: Turmeric Cauliflower Florets
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper to taste
description: A side dish of cauliflower florets seasoned with turmeric, garlic, and onion powder. The turmeric provides a distinct color and flavor.
instructions: In a bowl, combine cauliflower florets and olive oil. Toss to coat evenly.
Add ground turmeric, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until the florets are uniformly seasoned.
Arrange the seasoned cauliflower in the cooking basket in a single layer.
Cook at 300°F (150°C) for 10 minutes. Shake the basket at the 5-minute mark to promote even cooking.
Remove from the basket and serve immediately.
tip: Ensure florets are thoroughly coated with the spice blend for a uniform color and flavor.

title: Roasted Cauliflower with Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 3.72 fl oz extra virgin olive oil
description: Roasted cauliflower florets served with a tahini and lemon juice sauce.
instructions: Remove leaves and trim the base of the cauliflower. Break into florets and place in a large bowl.
Add olive oil, salt, and pepper to the cauliflower. Toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the cauliflower florets in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 356°F for 15 minutes. Shake the basket at the halfway point to ensure even cooking.
While the cauliflower is cooking, prepare the sauce by whisking together tahini and lemon juice until smooth. Spread the sauce on a serving plate and arrange the cooked cauliflower on top.
tip: Shaking the basket halfway through the cooking time promotes even browning and prevents burning.

title: Crispy Potato Chips
description: Thinly sliced potatoes cooked until crisp. This recipe yields a light, savory snack or side dish using minimal oil.
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve salt in cold water.
Wash potatoes thoroughly. Leaving the skin on is optional. Slice potatoes to a uniform thickness of 1.5 mm using a mandoline.
Submerge potato slices in the saltwater solution for 30 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain and rinse the potato slices. Dry them completely using a clean kitchen towel or paper towels.
In a bowl, toss the dried potato slices with olive oil until evenly coated.
Place the coated slices into the basket. Cook at 330°F for 23-26 minutes. Shake the basket vigorously every 5 minutes to separate the slices and ensure even cooking.
tip: A mandoline is required for uniform slice thickness, which ensures even cooking. The soaking and drying steps are critical for achieving a crispy texture and should not be omitted.

title: Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: Freshly Ground Black Pepper, to taste
description: A side dish characterized by an intense flavor. This cooking method yields mushrooms that are tender internally and golden-brown externally, minimizing water release.
instructions: Gently wipe the mushrooms with a damp cloth or paper towel to remove any soil residue.
Cut mushrooms into halves or quarters, ensuring uniform size for even cooking.
In a bowl, toss the mushrooms with extra virgin olive oil, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Arrange the mushrooms in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket at the halfway point to ensure even browning.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
tip: Do not wash mushrooms under running water. They are highly absorbent and excess moisture will prevent proper browning, resulting in a soggy texture.

title: Roasted Eggplant Slices
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
description: Roasted eggplant slices seasoned with a blend of powdered spices. A simple and flavorful side dish.
instructions: Wash and partially peel the eggplant. Cut into 1/2-inch thick round slices.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, ground cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add eggplant slices to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the slices in a single layer in the preheated cooking basket. Do not overcrowd.
Cook at 400°F for 10 minutes. Flip the slices halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Ensure all slices have a uniform thickness for even cooking.

title: Grilled Eggplant with Basil Pesto
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: Eggplant slices cooked until tender and finished with a layer of fresh basil pesto.
instructions: Rinse the eggplants and slice them into 0.2-inch thick rounds.
Coat both sides of the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Arrange the slices in a single layer. Cook at 338°F for 20 minutes, flipping the slices halfway through the cooking time.
Remove the basket and brush the top of each slice with basil pesto.
Continue cooking at maximum temperature for an additional 5-7 minutes.
tip: To prevent burning and preserve its color, apply the pesto only during the final minutes of cooking.

title: Parmigiana-Style Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 2 small-to-medium eggplants, stems removed, halved lengthwise
description: Eggplant shells filled with a mixture of their own flesh, tomato, and mozzarella, then cooked until tender.
instructions: Score the flesh of the eggplant halves in a diamond pattern. Brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the eggplant halves in the cooking basket, cut-side down. Cook at 375°F for 20 minutes until softened.
Carefully remove the eggplant. Using a spoon, scoop out the inner flesh, leaving a 1/4-inch border to create a shell. Avoid piercing the skin.
Finely chop the extracted eggplant flesh. In a mixing bowl, combine the chopped flesh with tomato puree, cherry tomatoes, diced mozzarella, and basil leaves. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling into the eggplant shells. Top with grated Parmesan cheese. Return to the cooking basket and cook at 400°F for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden.
tip: When scooping out the flesh, leave a 1/4-inch border to ensure the eggplant shells maintain their shape.

title: Roasted Frozen Potato Wedges
description: A side dish prepared from frozen. The wedges achieve a tender interior and a crisp exterior.
instructions: Place the frozen potato wedges directly into the basket. Do not add oil.
Cook at 375°F for 20 minutes.
After 10 minutes, remove the basket and shake to separate the wedges.
Continue cooking for the remaining 10 minutes, or until the desired level of crispness is reached. Season with salt before serving.
tip: Do not add extra oil if the product is pre-fried. The circulating hot air is sufficient for cooking.

title: Spiced Potato Wedges
ingredients: 0.85 fl oz extra virgin olive oil
description: Potato wedges seasoned with Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, and onion powder.
instructions: Wash potatoes. With skin on, cut into uniform wedges.
In a large bowl, add olive oil to the wedges and toss to coat evenly.
Add garlic powder, onion powder, Parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Arrange the wedges in a single layer in the preheated air fryer basket. Cook at 385°F for 20 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: For extra crispiness, soak cut wedges in cold water for 30 minutes. Dry completely before seasoning.

title: Whole Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes (approx. 6.7 oz / 190g each), uniform in size
description: Classic jacket potatoes with a crispy skin and a soft, creamy interior.
instructions: Scrub the potatoes under running water. Dry thoroughly.
Prick each potato 3-4 times with a fork to allow steam to escape during cooking.
For a crispier skin, lightly coat the potatoes with oil and rub with coarse salt.
Arrange the potatoes in the basket. Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 35-40 minutes, depending on size.
Verify doneness by inserting a knife into the center; it should meet no resistance.
tip: After cooking, slice lengthwise and gently squeeze the ends to open. Serve immediately with butter or sour cream.

title: Roasted Baby Potatoes with Spicy Mayonnaise
description: Roasted baby potatoes seasoned with spices, served with a mayonnaise-based dipping sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the halved potatoes with olive oil, half of the total paprika, half of the garlic powder, and salt. Toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the seasoned potatoes in a single layer in the cooking basket. Cook at 355°F for 30 minutes.
At the 15-minute mark, shake the basket or toss the potatoes with tongs to ensure even browning.
While the potatoes are cooking, prepare the sauce. In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, sun-dried tomato pesto, wine vinegar, and the remaining paprika and garlic powder until smooth.
Once cooked, transfer the potatoes to a serving dish. Serve immediately with the prepared sauce.
tip: For very small potatoes, they may be left whole. Extend the cooking time by approximately 5 minutes if necessary.

title: Classic Hash Brown Patties
ingredients: 21 oz frozen shredded hash brown patties
description: Potato patties cooked to a golden-brown finish without added fat.
instructions: Arrange the frozen hash brown patties in the cooking basket in a single, non-overlapping layer.
Do not add oil. The product contains sufficient fat for cooking.
Set the appliance to 355°F and cook for a total of 20 minutes.
After 10 minutes, open the basket and flip each patty with tongs or a spatula to ensure even browning.
tip: Arrange patties in a single layer to ensure maximum crispness and prevent breakage.

title: Hasselback Potatoes
description: Potatoes thinly sliced crosswise, remaining attached at the base. The exterior becomes crispy, while the interior absorbs the seasoned butter.
instructions: Wash and scrub the potatoes, leaving the skin on. Place each potato on a cutting board and make parallel, 1/4-inch incisions, stopping before cutting completely through the base.
Coat the potatoes with olive oil. Season generously with salt and pepper, ensuring seasoning enters the incisions.
Arrange the potatoes in the cooking basket. Cook at 350°F for 30 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, combine the melted butter, garlic powder, and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
After 30 minutes, remove the basket. Brush the potatoes with the garlic butter mixture, ensuring it coats the inside of the slits. Return to cook for an additional 10 minutes.
tip: To prevent cutting completely through the potato, place a chopstick or wooden spoon handle on each side of the potato to act as a guide for the knife.

title: Herb-Roasted Baby Potatoes
ingredients: 8.1 oz baby potatoes, washed and halved
description: A side dish of baby potatoes roasted to achieve a crispy exterior and a tender interior.
instructions: Wash the baby potatoes and cut them in half.
In a bowl, toss the potatoes with olive oil until evenly coated.
Add garlic powder, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and pepper. Toss to ensure even seasoning.
Arrange the potatoes in a single layer in the cooking basket. Cook at 383°F for 20 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time (at the 10-minute mark) to promote even browning.
tip: For enhanced browning, arrange the potato halves with the cut side facing up.

title: Whole Roasted Bell Peppers
description: A technique for roasting bell peppers to easily remove the skin. The high heat blisters and chars the exterior, resulting in a tender pulp suitable for various recipes.
instructions: Wash the bell peppers under running water and pat dry with a kitchen towel.
Coat the bell peppers with a thin layer of oil.
Place the whole peppers in the basket and set the temperature to 400°F.
Cook for 26-30 minutes. Halfway through cooking, turn the peppers using tongs.
Remove the peppers when wilted and slightly charred. Place them in a paper bag and seal for 10 minutes. The skin will then peel off easily.
tip: Placing the cooked peppers in a sealed bag or a covered pot allows the residual steam to separate the outer skin, facilitating removal.

title: Crispy Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 sweet white onion, cut into 0.5-inch thick rings
description: A classic appetizer featuring onion rings with a seasoned, crisp coating, prepared with a reduced-oil cooking method.
instructions: Slice the onion into 0.5-inch thick rounds. Separate the layers to form individual rings.
Prepare three shallow dishes. Place flour in the first. Whisk eggs and buttermilk together in the second. Combine breadcrumbs, salt, and paprika in the third.

Coat each onion ring first in flour, shaking off any excess. Dip it into the egg and buttermilk mixture, allowing excess to drip off. Press the ring firmly into the breadcrumb mixture to ensure a complete coating.
Arrange the coated rings in a single layer in the cooking basket. Work in batches if necessary to avoid overcrowding. Spray the rings with cooking oil.
Cook at 375°F for 10 minutes per batch, or until golden brown and crisp.
tip: For a more adherent coating, place the breaded rings in the freezer for 5 minutes before cooking. This helps set the breading.

title: Candied BBQ Bacon
description: Bacon fat renders and combines with sugar and spices, creating a crisp, caramelized coating with a smoky flavor profile. Suitable as an appetizer or breakfast component.
instructions: Cut each bacon slice in half.
In a small bowl, combine brown sugar, chili powder, ground cumin, and cayenne pepper.
Thoroughly coat each bacon slice with the sugar and spice mixture.
Arrange the coated bacon slices in a single layer inside the cooking basket, ensuring they are spaced apart.
Cook at 320°F for 8 minutes. Allow to cool for one minute before serving to let the caramel harden.
tip: Check for doneness at the 6-minute mark. The sugar can burn quickly.

title: Sweet and Mustard Crusted Steaks
ingredients: Coarse sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper
description: The application of intense heat sears the meat, facilitating the rapid melting of the sweet rub to form a robust aromatic crust.
instructions: Allow meat to reach room temperature by removing it from refrigeration 30 minutes prior to cooking, ensuring even thermal distribution.
Combine sugar, mustard powder, coarse salt, and cracked pepper in a small vessel.
Apply dry rub generously to both surfaces of the steaks, ensuring firm adhesion by manual pressure.
Position meat on the preheated cooking apparatus rack.
Cook at 400°F for 10 minutes, inverting the product at the midpoint of the cooking cycle. A medium doneness is typically achieved at 8 minutes.
tip: Elevated initial thermal exposure facilitates the retention of internal moisture within the meat's cellular structure, thereby mitigating desiccation.

title: Brussels Sprouts with Pancetta
ingredients: 10.6 oz small Brussels sprouts, washed, trimmed, and halved
description: A preparation method for Brussels sprouts and pancetta. The high-heat cooking process chars the outer leaves and renders fat from the pancetta, which coats the vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the halved Brussels sprouts and diced pancetta.
Add olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix to coat evenly.
Transfer the mixture to the cooking basket.
Cook at 400°F for 9 minutes. Shake the basket at the halfway point to ensure even cooking.
Transfer the cooked vegetables to a serving bowl. Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese before serving.
tip: Halving the Brussels sprouts reduces cooking time and promotes even tenderness.

title: Kale Chips
ingredients: Vegetable oil or olive oil spray, 0.3 fl oz
description: A quick method for preparing light and crispy kale chips. A healthy snack option.
instructions: Remove the leafy parts of the kale from the central stems. Discard the stems.
Thoroughly dry the leaves with paper towels. Lightly coat the leaves with oil.
Arrange the kale in a single layer in the cooking basket. Do not overcrowd to ensure proper air circulation.
Cook at 300°F (150°C) for 8-10 minutes, tossing the leaves halfway through the cooking time.
Remove from the appliance, season with sea salt, and serve immediately for optimal crispness.
tip: Ensure the kale is completely dry before cooking to prevent steaming and achieve a crispy texture.

title: Dehydrated Apple Slices
description: Low-temperature dehydration transforms fresh apples into a crisp, healthy snack.
instructions: Wash, peel, and core the apples.
Slice the apples into uniform 3mm thick rounds using a mandoline or a sharp knife.
Immerse the slices in a bowl of cold water mixed with lemon juice to prevent oxidation. Pat dry thoroughly.
Arrange the slices in a single layer on the cooking rack, ensuring they do not overlap.
Dehydrate at 175°F for 4 hours, or until crispy.
tip: For optimal results, use a mandoline to achieve a consistent 3mm thickness. This ensures even crispness.

title: Rustic Pear Tart
ingredients: 3.5 oz all-purpose flour (3.2 oz for dough, 0.35 oz for dusting)
1 large pear, peeled and thinly sliced
description: A free-form tart, also known as a galette, with a flaky pastry crust and a sliced pear filling. Baked until golden and garnished with honey and walnuts.
instructions: In a bowl, combine 3.2 oz of flour, granulated sugar, and salt. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the cold water and mix briefly until a dough forms. Do not overwork. Wrap the dough in plastic film and refrigerate for one hour.
In a separate bowl, toss the sliced pears with cornstarch and brown sugar.
On a surface dusted with the remaining 0.35 oz of flour, roll the chilled dough into an 8-inch disk.
Arrange the pear mixture in the center of the dough, leaving a 2-inch border. Fold the edges of the dough up and over the filling.
Bake at 320°F for 45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Allow to cool slightly. Garnish with honey and chopped toasted walnuts before serving.
tip: For a flakier crust, ensure both the butter and water are kept as cold as possible before mixing.

title: Roasted Green Beans
description: Cooking green beans at a high temperature eliminates excess moisture, resulting in a crisp-tender texture. This method produces a roasted and crisp side dish.
instructions: Trim the ends of the green beans.
In a bowl, combine green beans, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the seasoned green beans in the cooking basket in a single layer. Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 12-14 minutes. Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Thoroughly dry the green beans after washing. Excess moisture will cause them to steam instead of roast, preventing them from crisping.

title: Spiced Chickpea Falafel
description: A low-fat preparation of falafel. This method yields a product with a spiced, soft interior and a crisp, golden-brown exterior.
instructions: In a food processor, pulse the cooked chickpeas with parsley, cilantro, ground cumin, and tahini. Maintain a coarse texture; do not process into a fine puree.
Finely dice the onion and crush the garlic. Fold into the chickpea mixture and press firmly to form a compact dough.
Form the mixture into small, firm spheres with a smooth surface.
Place spheres in the air fryer basket, spaced apart. Spray lightly with oil. Cook at 340°F for 15 minutes, turning halfway through for even browning.
tip: Spray each falafel with oil before cooking to achieve a golden-brown color and a crisp texture.

title: Greek-Style Fries with Feta and Oregano
ingredients: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil or vegetable oil
Fresh parsley and oregano, chopped, to taste
Salt and black pepper, to taste
description: A side dish of fried potatoes garnished with feta cheese, fresh parsley, and oregano. Suitable as an appetizer or a side.
instructions: Cut potatoes into uniform sticks. Soak in a bowl of cold water for 15 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain the potatoes, rinse under running water, and dry thoroughly with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine dried potatoes with oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix until evenly coated.
Preheat the appliance to 383°F. Place potatoes in the basket and cook for 25-28 minutes. Shake the basket every 10 minutes to ensure even cooking.
Transfer cooked potatoes to a serving bowl. Immediately garnish with crumbled feta, fresh parsley, and oregano.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.
tip: Garnish with feta and herbs after cooking. Applying them during the cooking process will cause the cheese to melt excessively and separate.

title: Curly Fries
description: Cook frozen curly fries to achieve a golden, crisp texture without additional oil. This method ensures evenly cooked spirals directly from the freezer.
instructions: Place the frozen curly fries directly into the cooking basket.
Do not add oil. The product is pre-fried and will release sufficient oil during cooking to achieve a golden-brown color.
Cook at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning. If necessary, shake again 5 minutes before the end of the cooking cycle.
tip: Do not overfill the basket. Ensure there is enough space for hot air to circulate for even cooking.

title: Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 5.3 oz sweet peas, fresh or frozen
description: Triangular pastries filled with a mixture of cauliflower, peas, and feta cheese.
instructions: Steam or pan-cook the cauliflower florets and peas until tender.
In a bowl, mash the cooked vegetables with crumbled feta cheese. Season with salt and pepper to create a coarse mixture.
Halve the pastry sheets. Place a spoonful of the vegetable mixture on one end of each half and fold into a triangle, enclosing the filling.
Seal the final edge of the pastry with the beaten egg yolk. Brush the surface of each triangle with olive oil.
Arrange the samosas in the cooking basket. Cook at 340°F for 15 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden brown and crisp.
tip: Ensure the vegetable filling is not excessively moist to prevent the pastry from becoming soggy or tearing. Pat dry if necessary.

title: Banana and Mascarpone Cake
description: A dense cake featuring a pronounced banana flavor from very ripe fruit, complemented by a mascarpone frosting.
instructions: Peel and mash the bananas with a fork to a coarse pulp.
Whisk in the dark brown sugar and sunflower oil until well combined.
Sift and gradually incorporate the self-rising flour using a spatula. Fold in the chopped walnuts.
Pour the batter into a suitable cake pan.
Bake at 320°F for approximately 35 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Frost the top with mascarpone.
tip: Verify doneness by inserting a toothpick into the center of the cake. If it emerges clean, the cake is fully baked.

title: Breaded Whole Mushrooms
ingredients: 10.6 oz frozen, pre-breaded whole or quartered mushrooms
description: A quick method for preparing frozen breaded mushrooms, suitable as a side dish or appetizer.
instructions: Place the frozen breaded mushrooms directly into the cooking basket.
Arrange the mushrooms in a single layer.
Do not add oil; the pre-breaded coating contains sufficient fat for cooking.
Cook at 375°F for 15 to 18 minutes, until the coating is golden brown and crisp.
Halfway through the cooking time, shake the basket vigorously to ensure even browning.
tip: Do not thaw the mushrooms before cooking to prevent moisture from compromising the breading. Shaking the basket halfway through the cooking process is essential for a uniform result.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: A classic American toasted sandwich, characterized by a crisp, golden crust and a melted cheese center.
instructions: Preheat the appliance to 320°F.
Brush one side of each bread slice with melted butter.
Place the cheese slices on the unbuttered side of two bread slices. Top with the remaining bread slices, buttered-side up.
Place the assembled sandwiches in the basket and cook for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove when golden brown. Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
tip: Apply butter only to the outer sides of the bread to achieve a golden crust.

title: Cajun-Style Shrimp
description: Shrimp seasoned with Cajun spices. Suitable as a main protein or for use in tacos and flatbreads.
instructions: Rinse shrimp and pat dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, combine shrimp, olive oil, fine sea salt, and Cajun seasoning. Toss to coat evenly.
Preheat the appliance to 375°F.
Arrange the seasoned shrimp in a single layer in the basket.
Cook for 5 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through the cooking time.
Remove from the appliance and serve immediately.
tip: To prevent a tough texture, do not overcook the shrimp. Serve with fresh citrus wedges to complement the spice.

title: Roasted Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 large fresh ear of yellow sweet corn
0.5 oz of softened or melted butter
description: This recipe provides a quick preparation for a sweet and savory corn side dish, suitable for grilled meats or as a summer snack.
instructions: Remove husks and silk from the corn. Cut the ear in half.
Brush corn kernels thoroughly with melted butter and season with salt.
Place corn in the cooking appliance basket. Initiate cooking at 400°F.
Cook for 10 minutes, rotating halfway through to ensure uniform browning.
tip: Rotate the corn midway through the cooking cycle to ensure uniform toasting and optimal aroma development.

title: Pepperoni Mini Pizzas
ingredients: 2 round pre-made pizza dough crusts (approx. 7 inches)
Light coating of high-quality oil for brushing the base
6 oz mozzarella, shredded or torn into small pieces
1.8 oz finely grated Grana Padano cheese
description: Rapid preparation yielding a crisp base, achieved by initial dough toasting, which prevents saturation from toppings.
instructions: Apply a thin layer of oil to the flattened dough rounds. Preheat the air fryer to 320°F (160°C).
Position the unadorned dough within the air fryer basket. Toast for 5 minutes.
Carefully extract the pre-baked crust. Distribute tomato sauce evenly, then layer with shredded mozzarella and grated cheese.
Arrange pepperoni slices uniformly over the cheese layer.
Return to the air fryer. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted and exhibits bubbling.
tip: Pre-baking the dough prior to topping application is recommended to mitigate base saturation.

title: Roasted Garlic and Parmesan Baguette
description: This preparation results in a baguette featuring a crisp crust and a tender, butter-infused crumb, suitable as an accompaniment to various dishes, particularly hearty soups.
instructions: Slice the baguette lengthwise, then crosswise into uniform, thick pieces to maximize surface area for absorption.
In a small bowl, combine butter, olive oil, grated Parmesan, and minced garlic until homogenous.
Distribute the garlic butter mixture thoroughly and uniformly over the surface of each bread slice.
Place the prepared bread into the cooking appliance basket and cook at 320°F for 8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley prior to serving.
tip: Apply the garlic butter mixture thoroughly prior to cooking; heat facilitates absorption into the bread's structure, contributing to optimal crispness.

title: Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 tbsp (0.5 oz) extra virgin olive oil
description: A method for preparing corn on the cob, resulting in a crisp texture, golden-brown exterior, and enhanced sweetness.
instructions: Remove husks and silks from corn. Wash and pat dry.
Apply olive oil evenly to cobs. Season generously with coarse sea salt.
Arrange cobs in a single layer within the air fryer basket to ensure optimal air circulation and uniform browning.
Cook at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, rotating cobs midway through cooking to achieve consistent charring.
tip: Ensure complete removal of husks and silks prior to oil application. Frequent rotation during cooking promotes uniform browning and charring.

title: Mexican-Style Puff Pastry Wreaths
ingredients: 2 pre-made soft puff pastry discs (approx. 6.7 inches diameter)
Extra virgin olive oil for brushing
4.2 oz of zesty Mexican-style sauce (sweet and spicy)
6 oz of shredded Mexican cheese blend (e.g., Cheddar, Monterey Jack)
1.4 oz sweet corn kernels (thawed) and 2.1 oz black beans, mixed with a small handful (0.5 oz) of peas
description: This recipe combines a crispy pastry base with Tex-Mex ingredients, including black beans, corn, and melted cheese, creating a savory snack.
instructions: Preheat the cooking appliance to 320°F.
Lightly brush pastry discs with olive oil. Place discs into the cooking appliance basket.
Bake pastry bases for 5 minutes, or until lightly golden. Carefully remove.
Distribute Mexican sauce over the bases. Top with shredded cheese, black beans, corn, and peas.
Return to the cooking appliance. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbling.
tip: To prevent the pastry base from becoming soggy, apply wet toppings and cheese exclusively during the final 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Patties
ingredients: 5 oz (142g) fresh spinach, sautéed and moisture-extracted
1 whole egg (or 2 tablespoons starch for vegan preparation)
0.07 oz (2g) cumin and 0.07 oz (2g) sweet paprika
Salt, pepper, and non-stick cooking spray
description: These homemade vegetable patties offer a tender interior and a crisp exterior, suitable for sandwiches or as a main course. The preparation method minimizes fat absorption.
instructions: Combine chickpeas, thoroughly squeezed spinach, spices, salt, pepper, and egg in a blender or food processor.
Process until a moldable, rustic-textured mixture is achieved; avoid over-processing.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, incorporate breadcrumbs, and knead. Form into four large patties using dampened hands.
Lightly coat the cooking appliance basket with non-stick spray. Arrange patties within the basket and lightly spray their surfaces.
Cook at 355°F (179°C) for 14 minutes, carefully turning patties midway through the cooking cycle.
tip: Thoroughly extract moisture from the spinach prior to blending. Residual water content will compromise mixture consistency, hindering patty formation.

title: Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini Boats
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil
description: This preparation yields a versatile dish suitable as a side or main course. Zucchini undergoes thermal softening, while the cheese filling achieves volumetric expansion and surface browning.
instructions: Clean zucchini, bisect longitudinally, and excavate central pulp using a spoon or melon baller to form cavities.
Mince extracted pulp and combine in a vessel with ricotta, Parmesan, egg, mint, sodium chloride, and piper nigrum.
Apply a thin layer of olive oil to the interior of the zucchini cavities. Subsequently, fill generously with the ricotta mixture.
Arrange prepared zucchini in a single layer within the cooking apparatus. Process at 350°F for approximately 16 minutes.
Extract from the cooking apparatus upon achieving fork-tender zucchini consistency and optimal browning of the filling.
tip: Pre-drain ricotta in a fine-mesh sieve for a minimum of one hour prior to incorporation. Failure to do so will result in excessive whey release, compromising the textural integrity of the filling.

title: Gratinated Bell Pepper Strips
ingredients: 2 large fleshy bell peppers (red or yellow)
description: Bell pepper strips, when subjected to high heat, develop a pronounced sweetness. This preparation features a savory, rustic, and crunchy breadcrumb topping.
instructions: Wash bell peppers, remove stem, seeds, and internal membranes. Cut into wide strips.
Combine breadcrumbs, capers, minced garlic, parsley, salt, pepper, and half of the olive oil in a small bowl to form the breadcrumb mixture.
Arrange pepper strips in the cooking basket, concave side facing upward.
Fill each strip with the prepared breadcrumb mixture. Drizzle remaining olive oil over the filled strips.
Cook at 365°F for 14 minutes, or until peppers are softened and breadcrumbs are golden brown.
tip: For an intensified savory profile, incorporate two finely chopped anchovy fillets into the breadcrumb mixture. Adjust salt content as necessary.

title: Parmesan Crusted Green Asparagus
description: This recipe provides a rapid method for preparing green asparagus. The combination of melted cheese and almond flakes forms a savory, aromatic crust on the tender stalks.
instructions: Wash asparagus and remove woody ends by snapping them manually at their natural breaking point.
Place asparagus in a tray or dish, drizzle with olive oil, and toss to ensure even coating.
Arrange asparagus in a single layer within the cooking basket and season with salt and pepper.
Generously sprinkle Parmesan and almond flakes, concentrating application on the tips.
Cook at 375°F (190°C) for approximately 8 minutes, or until the cheese develops an amber crust.
tip: Avoid overcooking to preserve optimal color and textural integrity.

title: Roasted Fennel Wedges
ingredients: Coarse salt and black pepper to taste
description: Roasting fennel mitigates its inherent anise flavor, yielding a tender, sweet profile enhanced by a citrus finish.
instructions: Prepare fennel by removing tough upper stalks and fibrous outer layers.
Halve each bulb, then cut into 6-8 uniform wedges, ensuring the core remains intact to maintain structural integrity.
In a bowl, combine fennel wedges with olive oil, salt, pepper, and optional fennel seeds.
Arrange wedges in a single layer within the cooking basket. Cook at 355°F for 15 minutes, turning halfway through the cooking cycle.
Serve promptly, garnished with fresh lemon juice.
tip: Retain a segment of the base core within each wedge to ensure structural cohesion during the cooking process.

title: Sweet and Sour Red Onions
